snippet.title: EchoEvade Game Trailer
snippet.description:
STEAM LINK: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3557670 (you'll have to paste it over, sorry)

EchoEvade is a fast-paced action rhythm game, where you dodge, click or catch to the beat. Precision and movement are key.

• Avoid Echoes, Catch Rebounders, and tap on Pulse notes.
• Pay Attention - Charts can get intense, making you read their challenging patterns as you go!
• Limited Mistakes - Every action is crucial. If your focus fails for even a second, you might have to retry the whole chart!
• Compete for the Top - Gain Echo Points by completing charts, and see how you rank amongst other players all around the world!
